svg.title: Generate Common questions with global lock and durable lease

g.text: Generate Common questions with global lock and durable lease
Session advisory lock remains held during generation;
[Owner missing / inactive or job deleted / lease replaced]
[At least one insert and available count > 15]
[Failure / no new words / still low bank]
File-backed SQLite uses a nonblocking OS file lock instead.
Bank requests can reset failed jobs after a 60-second cooldown.
